svg.title: FrozenLake training: mean logprob difference and training solve rate
svg.desc: Standard, token-level TIS, and Zero-TIM over the first 200 training observations, displayed as steps 1–200. Left: unsmoothed mean absolute sampler–trainer logprob difference over sampled action tokens. Right: raw training solve rates and a ten-step trailing average. Endpoint labels show the final ten-step averages as percentages. All values are measured; the Zero-TIM mean difference is zero at every plotted step.
